criterion_scores.reasoning: I checked the executable behavior of the main contract: parse input (lines 16-18), derive metrics/meta (35-63), build the record (66-76), append the authoritative JSONL record (80-82), then optionally project to PostHog (84-91). The major issue is on the primary write path: line 82 ignores append failure, and line 81 is also unchecked, so the script can fail to persist the source-of-truth record while still exiting 0. That is a real send-back defect for a telemetry emitter whose first responsibility is the authoritative append.

The artifact includes the expected pieces for this hook: input/session gating (16-18), disable override handling (20-26), transcript-derived metrics (35-47), defensive normalization (49-54), optional session meta (56-63), authoritative local record construction and append (65-82), and optional external projection (84-91). The one nit I found is the missing `.claude/settings.local.json` reference at line 21; it is guarded and therefore not load-bearing here, but that override path is unavailable in this repo snapshot. [harness cap 0.6: check-refs: referenced file(s) missing]

For a repo hook, placement and style are appropriate: it lives under `.claude/hooks/`, keeps a local source-of-truth record before any derived projection (lines 80-91), and the implementation matches the stated content-gating intent by emitting counts/metadata rather than bodies (35-76). I did not see house-rule violations like alex-prefixed project skills, MCP misuse, or forbidden write-path bypasses in this script. I stay just below 1.0 because the wider hook-contract file is only referenced, not supplied here.

I specifically checked for overbuilt telemetry/platform behavior, tombstoned tool resurrection, duplicated state, fabricated specificity, and hardcoded secrets. The script stays lean: one append-only local record plus an optional derived PostHog adapter (4-8, 80-91), explicitly defers OTEL/Langfuse in comments, and keeps the network call best-effort rather than making the system depend on it. I found no consequential anti-patterns in the implementation.

I checked whether failures are loud and whether comments match behavior. The main weakness is that the authoritative write path is silent on failure: the script uses `set -uo pipefail` (13) but not `set -e`, does not check `mkdir` or the append at lines 81-82, and then exits 0 regardless. That combines an opaque failure mode with overstated framing in the 'always' comment at line 80, so diagnostics falls below the pass line.

defects.description: The core source-of-truth write is not checked. If directory creation or append fails, the script still continues and can even project to PostHog, so the artifact does not reliably satisfy its own stated contract to always append the authoritative local `build_session` record.

The comments promise an 'always' authoritative append, but the implementation neither enables `set -e` nor checks `mkdir`/append status or emits any failure signal. Primary-write loss is therefore silent and hard to diagnose.

This historical repo state references a local disable-override file that is verified missing. The code guards the absence with `-f`, so it is not load-bearing, but the advertised override path is not exercisable in this snapshot.

checks_performed: Traced the main execution path from stdin ingestion through session_id parsing, transcript/meta extraction, JSON record construction, authoritative JSONL append, and optional PostHog projection, including all early exits.
Checked the primary write path and failure handling on `mkdir`, JSON record creation, file append, and `curl`, with attention to whether the hook is silent only on success or also on failure.
Verified the content-gating claim against the actual emitted fields: timestamps, counts, tool names, booleans, and nullable meta only; no prompt/tool-input/output bodies are written.
Checked referenced files and contracts visible from the artifact, including the supplied missing-reference fact for `.claude/settings.local.json`, and judged whether that reference is load-bearing.

Checked house-convention / anti-pattern concerns visible in the script: hook placement, single source-of-truth local record plus derived projection, no tombstoned OTEL/Langfuse resurrection, no secrets hardcoded, and no obvious duplicated measurement store.
